scope: Independent source and earlier actual screenshot review; parent owns native browser QA. This reviewer did not operate the browser or repeat the full backend suite.

findings.problem: NPC target locations could authorize a conversation and screen pick before the displayed NPC crossed a room portal.
findings.reproduction: Felix authority=street, rendered scene=bakery and position=(810,229.5); player street at(810,350); servernearby includes Felix. Prior displayedNear returned true through the room frontage. Reverse incoming direction also failed.
findings.disposition: Root added per-actor displayed scene tracking, portal crossing and screen-pick gating.
findings.verification: Two actual displayedNear prototype tests failed before fix; all11 shipped-renderer method tests now pass.

findings.problem: Conversation selected changed camera distance by18% in one frame despite smoothed focus.
findings.disposition: Root added damped cameraEffectiveDistance, with explicit reduced-motion immediate behavior.
findings.verification: Actual updateCamera tests cover first-frame partial motion, convergence and closing transition; reduced motion immediate selection is separate.

findings.problem: loading_ms began after bundle/import loading, so it could not represent complete navigation-to-playable loading.
findings.disposition: Reported to root before final benchmarks; final report must distinguish app boot from navigation-to-ready.

findings.problem: Unbounded camera orbit combined with roof-only cutaway can potentially hide a player near a full-height interior wall.
findings.disposition: Reported for native interior check or a restricted semi-orbit arc; not reproduced by this reviewer in a browser.

focused_tests.scope: Shipped DistrictRenderer methods with fake GPU/entity/camera surfaces and independent authoritative/rendered states; no native input, pixel or FPS claim.

checked_boundaries: Public projection excludes operator mind state and rejects Lab snapshots; the bridge normalizes shared Lab responses without retrying accepted actions.
Confirmation posts only server-issued proposal and interpretation IDs. Simulation resources stay server-owned; duplicate in-flight confirmation shares one promise.
Movement remaining distance is in simulator units, matching the48-unit authority bound and12-unit visual catch-up gate.
NPC work poses are selected from reported activity; locomotion is selected from changed displayed position.
Static model and scenery do not create economic inventory; cart cargo rendering is tied to actual story stage.
Binary asset route is resolved within its mount, uses explicit MIME types and preserves legacy client/API routes.
limits: Root native walkthrough/performance artifacts are required to establish the visual and gameplay acceptance checks.
Collision uses existing authoritative clear floor/portal geometry, not Recast or a general rigid-body/furniture/NPC avoidance simulation.
Earlier inspected screenshot preceded final individual material palettes, cart and foliage; final visual quality needs the parent screenshot check.
Render-submission measurements do not establish GPU completion, compositor presentation or physical input latency.
No human enjoyment, physical-device or broad hardware performance claim is supported by this review.
